notes: Battle actions A/B/M/P need the matching card in hand (caster.hand_has.<code>, assumed context); EP/EM are always available (no card). Combat damage comes straight off the resolution matrix (rps_edge: Attack base 1 + one edge A>P, P>M, M>B, B>A; empty actions are read as the action they lose to). Move = 1 hex toward the target, Empty Move = ceil(dist/2) hexes (min 1 when the target is not the actor's tile). Meta codes COMBO/TRADE/ENTER/DOOR carry their paper preconditions. Assumed context fields beyond the README shape: caster.hand_has.<code>, caster.combo_complete, target.moving_toward_caster, target.is_start_tile, target.is_door, target.dimension_value, cast.ally_agrees.

action_attack.description: Attack card (A). Needs the card in hand and an enemy in contact (or an empty tile, which makes it a one-hex movement intent without damage). Combat damage = 1 base + 1 vs Posture / Empty Posture (A>P), 0 vs Block (B>A: the attacker takes 1 from the blocker unless they hold Ranged Weapon), 1 vs Move. Cannot emit non-instant effects (Reaver excepted); instants ride on it. Rule 15 follow: an Attack may chase a moving target.

prerequisites.description: An Attack card is in the caster's hand.
The right-clicked target is in contact (distance <= 1).
The target is an enemy unit or an empty tile.

effects.description: Matrix damage of the Attack against the defender's action (A>P/EP 2, vs M 1, vs B 0).
Damage the attacker takes back from a blocking defender: 1, or 0 with Ranged Weapon.
Swinging into an empty tile steps one hex toward it; a unit target is not approached.
Attack does not emit (Rule 20), except the Reaver stance.

validation.description: Attack beats exactly Posture in the 4-cycle.
Attack loses exactly to Block in the 4-cycle.

action_block.description: Block card (B). Needs the card in hand; takes no target. Scores 1 damage on every enemy in contact whose Attack is aimed at the blocker (B>A), 0 on anyone else; a Ranged Weapon attacker is out of reach. Loses to Move (M>B: the blocker takes 1 from a mover). Cannot emit non-instant effects (Barbarian paper exception).

prerequisites.description: A Block card is in the caster's hand.

effects.description: 1 on each adjacent enemy attacking the blocker, 0 if that attacker holds Ranged Weapon or does not Attack.
What the defender's action scores on the blocker (Move 1, Attack 0, others 0).
Block does not emit (Rule 20).

validation.description: Block beats exactly Attack in the 4-cycle.
Block loses exactly to Move in the 4-cycle.

action_move.description: Move card (M). Needs the card in hand and a target (tile or unit); the caster steps exactly one hex along the shortest path toward it, walking around occupied hexes. Scores 1 on a blocker in contact (M>B), takes 1 from a Posture (P>M). Interrupts a non-instant cast (Rule 19) except for the Monk; Move skills ride on it.

prerequisites.description: A Move card is in the caster's hand.
A destination tile or unit is chosen at distance >= 1.

effects.description: One hex toward the target.
Matrix damage of the Move against the defender (1 vs Block, else 0).
Move does not emit (Rule 19/20), except the Monk stance.

validation.description: Move beats exactly Block in the 4-cycle.
Move loses exactly to Posture in the 4-cycle.

action_posture.description: Posture card (P). Needs the card in hand; takes no target. The only real action that emits an element for a non-instant cast (Rule 20); Posture skills ride on it. Scores 1 on every adjacent enemy playing Move / Empty Move / Empty Posture (P>M), takes 2 from an Attack (A>P).

prerequisites.description: A Posture card is in the caster's hand.

effects.description: Posture emits: non-instant effects may advance.
The emission must not use an element a Disable barred for the caster.
1 on each adjacent enemy playing M/EM/EP, 0 otherwise.
What the defender's action scores on the poser (Attack 2, others 0).

validation.description: Posture beats exactly Move in the 4-cycle.
Posture loses exactly to Attack in the 4-cycle.

action_empty_posture.description: Empty Posture (EP): no card is played, so it is always available and returns nothing to the discard. It emits (casts advance) but has no bonus of its own: an attacking enemy reads it as Posture (takes 2), a posing enemy reads it as Move (takes 1), Move and Block neutralise it. Class stances rewrite it for the combat maths: Reaver -> A, Barbarian -> B, Monk -> M. Move and Posture skills ride on it. Sanctuary only protects while the declared action is EP.

prerequisites.description: No card is needed; EP can always be declared.

effects.description: Empty Posture emits.
The action combat is judged on after class stances: A / B for Reaver / Barbarian, else EP (the Monk's EP-as-Move stance was dropped, CR 2026-11-17).
EP deals nothing by itself (matrix row 0).
What the defender's action scores on a plain EP (Attack 2, Posture 1, Move/Block 0).
No card leaves the hand.

validation.description: An empty action has no edges of its own.

action_empty_move.description: Empty Move (EM): a declared-first way of playing Empty Posture; always available, no card. The caster walks ceil(dist/2) hexes along the shortest path toward the target tile (min 1 when the target is not the own tile), at the lowest movement priority (A > M > EM at a shared destination). It still emits (Rule 20) and has no bonus: Block reads it as Move (takes 1), Posture reads it as Move (takes 1). Reaver: fights as an Attack.

prerequisites.description: No card is needed; EM can always be declared (before the flip).
A destination tile at distance >= 1 is chosen.

effects.description: Halfway toward the target: ceil(dist / 2), at least 1.
Empty Move emits like Empty Posture.
The action combat is judged on: A for a Reaver, B for a Barbarian (CR 2026-11-18 (a); the EM still moves, ruling 2026-11-19), else EM.
What the defender's action scores on a plain EM (Posture 1, Block 1 per the data edges, Attack 0).

validation.description: An empty action has no edges of its own.
Empty Move keeps targeting a tile.

action_combo.description: Combo (meta): the character card lists a sequence of action codes; when the caster completes that sequence over consecutive actions while in contact with an enemy, the final action deals +1 bonus damage to that enemy. Not a card; no edges of its own; never emits.

prerequisites.description: The caster's last actions complete the character's combo sequence.
An enemy is in contact when the combo completes.

effects.description: +1 damage on the enemy in contact when the combo completes.
Matrix damage of the completing action plus the combo bonus.

validation.description: A meta action has no edges of its own.

action_trade.description: Trade (meta, Rule 14): spend one of the round's actions to swap archives with an allied character in contact who is moving toward the caster this action. Nothing else resolves for that action slot; no edges; never emits.

prerequisites.description: The target is an allied character in contact.
The partner's action this turn moves them toward the caster.

effects.description: The trade costs one action of the round.
Two archives change hands.

validation.description: A meta action has no edges of its own.

action_enter_dimension.description: Enter Dimension (meta, Rule 0 setup): a character not yet on the tileset drops onto a starting tile. The entry counts as a Move action for the resolution maths (M>B, loses to P) and may carry instants, but no non-instant emission. No edges of its own.

prerequisites.description: The caster has no tile yet (outside the Dimension).
The target is a starting tile.

effects.description: The entry resolves as a Move.
Matrix damage of the entry (as Move) against a defender met on arrival.
Instants may be cast during entry; non-instants may not.
A non-instant cast cannot advance on entry.

validation.description: A meta action has no edges of its own.

action_travel_door.description: Travel through a Dimension Door (meta): the caster stands on a door tile. With an ally's agreement on the far side the travel is immediate (0 rounds of channeling); otherwise the caster channels for as many rounds as the door's 'dimension value' before it opens. No edges of its own.

prerequisites.description: The caster stands on the door (distance 0 to a door tile).

effects.description: 0 with ally agreement, else the door's dimension value.
The door opens once the channeled rounds reach the need.

validation.description: A meta action has no edges of its own.
